resources.string: Control position, altitude, time zone, date and time independently in Custom scenario.
Keep a custom clock advancing across app restarts, or use the current date or time.
Review active overrides and the approximate place in Current scenario; the main icon shows their count.
Apply a position’s altitude and time zone together, with automatic saving and notices for each section.
Enabled Earth-reference labels stay visible in the main view and captures, independently of object-label choices.
The Earth screensaver now shows your last known position with corrected map orientation, eastward rotation and a seasonal perspective that follows the scenario date.
